caption:
Figure 1. Motivation of our method. (a) False matches tend to
occur in cross-modal features. We establish well-aligned image-
modal reference features thus transit the text-to-image matching to
image-to-image matching. (b) Indivdual matching tends to suffer
from disturbances. We propose a novel relation-aware matching
strategy for more robust region classification.
delegated_acceptance_review: Actually viewed the original-pixel final and the first generated draft, and reviewed all eight independent source/derivative observations. Both complete scientific panels are restored at native resolution. The upper modality comparison retains masked scene, all region/reference crops, erroneous-match crosses and directions; the lower panel retains chair features, category agents, ranking distributions, all scores including red 0.45 and bold 0.51, and the ochre/yellow legend. The new descriptive headings and robustness statements follow the motivation caption. No histogram normalization, hidden axis meaning, or new class outcome was introduced. First-draft synthetic image/curve rendering is excluded from the final scientific panels.
